items.title: Victory Capital Holdings (VCTR) Partners With Apollo, Is It Still A Bargain?

items.title: SpaceX Is Paying Up to 8.36% on $44 Billion of Debt for Nvidia Chips
items.summary: Lenders lined up to fund SpaceX's chip spree, then demanded a steep price for it. The real risk may be what happens to those GPUs, and to SpaceX's cash flow, before the first rent check clears.

items.title: Apollo views daily pricing as key to expanding alternatives access. Industry peers are skeptical.
items.summary: In the wake of several high-profile blowups in private credit, some managers have taken steps to improve transparency in an asset class known for its illiquidity and opacity. items.title: Apollo-backed insurer Athora weighs sale of Belgian unit, Bloomberg reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- Athora Holding Ltd., the European life insurer backed by Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO), is exploring a potential sale of its Belgian operations as part of a broader effort to sharpen its geographic focus, according to reporting from Bloomberg. The insurer has enlisted advisers to gauge preliminary interest from prospective buyers, though discussions remain at an early stage and management could still elect to retain the division.

items.title: APO Targets More Than 20% FRE Growth in 2027: What's Driving It?
items.summary: Apollo targets more than 20% FRE growth in 2027, backed by rising management fees, credit origination and capital-solutions activity.

items.title: Nvidia’s financing risks could keep AI chip stocks under pressure, analyst says
items.summary: Investing.com -- Nvidia’s troubled effort to mobilize financing for its customers could weigh on the broader AI semiconductor sector, according to Lynx Equity Strategies analyst KC Rajkumar, who cautioned that cheaper valuations alone may not be enough to lure investors back.
